logo.corroboration: nielsenpulse.com serves /assets/logos/nielsen_logo_full.svg (copied to brands/nielsen-pulse/logo/site_nielsen_logo_full.svg): same four triangle fills #F40953 #FF9408 #32BBB9 #6E37FA with a white wordmark - the reversed (on-dark) variant of the same mark. So the product site itself uses this logo.
logo.on_dark: the navy wordmark (#002041) will not read on a dark scene; the white-wordmark variant exists only as the site SVG (site_nielsen_logo_full.svg), which FFmpeg cannot render and must not be rasterized by us. Keep the logo band light.
